mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_COUNT, COUNT(CASE WHEN U.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 END) AS ACTIVE_COUNT, COUNT(CASE WHEN U.STATUS = 'DEACTIVATE' THEN 1 END) AS DEACTIVATED_COUNT FROM USERS U
SELECT COUNT(*) AS NEW_USER_COUNT FROM USERS WHERE REG_DT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND REG_DT < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 1)
SELECT COUNT(POST_ID) AS POST_COUNT FROM POST WHERE USE_YN = 'Y'

SELECT u.USER_ID, u.NAME, u.EMAIL, ( SELECT LISTAGG(sa.PROVIDER, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sa.PROVIDER) FROM SOCIAL_ACCOUNTS sa WHERE sa.USER_ID = u.USER_ID ) AS PROVIDER, u.ROLE, u.STATUS, u.REG_DT, u.LAST_LOGIN_DT, cf.FILE_PATH FROM USERS u LEFT JOIN CMM_FILE cf ON u.PROFILE_FILE_ID = cf.FILE_ID
AND u.NAME LIKE '%' || #{name} || '%'
AND u.EMAIL LIKE '%' || #{email} || '%'
ORDER BY u.USER_ID
mapper.update: UPDATE USERS SET ROLE = #{role}, MOD_DT = SYSDATE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.select:
SELECT COM_CD_ID, COM_CD_NM, USE_YN, SORT_SEQ, REG_ID, REG_DT, MOD_ID, MOD_DT FROM CMM_CODE
AND COM_CD_ID LIKE '%' || #{comCdId} || '%'
AND COM_CD_NM LIKE '%' || #{comCdNm} || '%'
AND USE_YN = #{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
ORDER BY SORT_SEQ, COM_CD_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CMM_CODE (COM_CD_ID, COM_CD_NM, USE_YN, SORT_SEQ, REG_ID, REG_DT) VALUES ( #{comCdId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{comCdNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sortSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{regId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE CMM_CODE SET USE_YN = 'N', MOD_ID = #{modId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, MOD_DT = SYSDATE WHERE COM_CD_ID = #{comCdId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
